fusions.name: Run It Down
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 6 tiles to the target, deals 12 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally beside you (max 30%).

fusions.name: Warning Snap
fusions.desc: Snaps at everything close, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles with a 30% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Guard the Pack
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds. A hound escort fights beside you for 13 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Barded Hound
fusions.desc: A hound in barding stays at your side and bites enemies within 4.5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds, slowing each one it bites by 20% for 2 seconds.
